crossRefs.note: My people will live in a peaceful habitation, in safe dwellings, and in quiet resting places,
Yahweh, who shall dwell in your sanctuary? Who shall live on your holy hill?
Lord, you have been our dwelling place for all generations.
He who dwells in the secret place of the Most High will rest in the shadow of the Almighty.
“Because he has set his love on me, therefore I will deliver him. I will set him on high, because he has known my name.
Yet he lifts the needy out of their affliction, and increases their families like a flock.
But whoever listens to me will dwell securely, and will be at ease, without fear of harm.”
Yahweh’s name is a strong tower: the righteous run to him, and are safe.
Yahweh, the Lord, is my strength. He makes my feet like deer’s feet, and enables me to go in high places. For the music…
In that day, this song will be sung in the land of Judah: “We have a strong city. God appoints salvation for walls and…

crossRefs.note: Behold, Yahweh’s eye is on those who fear him, on those who hope in his loving kindness,
The young lions do lack, and suffer hunger, but those who seek Yahweh shall not lack any good thing.
Trust in Yahweh, and do good. Dwell in the land, and enjoy safe pasture.
He has given food to those who fear him. He always remembers his covenant.
Don’t seek what you will eat or what you will drink; neither be anxious.

translations.web: he will dwell on high. His place of defense will be the fortress of rocks. His bread will be supplied. His waters will be sure.
translations.bsb: he will dwell on the heights; the mountain fortress will be his refuge; his food will be provided and his water assured.
translations.kjv: He shall dwell on high: his place of defence shall be the munitions of rocks: bread shall be given him; his waters shall be sure.
translations.asv: He shall dwell on high; his place of defence shall be the munitions of rocks; his bread shall be given him; his waters shall be sure.
